scope.description: Whole freecad application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Parametric solid/sketch modelling, PartDesign, assemblies, CAD import/export, drawings, surfaces, CAM and domain workbenches.

coverage.rationale: Mechanical modelling now has a composable multi-Body foundation with named constrained geometry, frames/face attachments, successive additive/subtractive histories, datum rotation, Body dress-ups, patterns and lofts. The enclosure/lid workflow independently exercises native parameter propagation and useful geometry handoffs. The retained conservative subjective breadth score is not an API ratio: important surface/BRep, mechanisms, manufacturing and simulation families remain open. One typed CAD-to-static-elasticity bridge now adds independently checked material, mesh, geometric support/traction, native solver/result and editable lifecycle coverage; broader simulation physics remain open. Common native drilling now preserves one drill/recess definition across explicit, grid and pitch-circle fastening locations; this advances mechanical workflows without closing broad application families. Uniform native Skin shells add open cups/tubes and a shelled enclosure composition, without closing general surfaces/offsets or the other workbenches. Native sweeps with editable bend paths and attached flanges advance the mechanical family; broad3D paths, surface modelling and other workbenches remain unfinished. Technical drawing and prescribed constant-speed Revolute/Slider motion add useful checked deliverables; broader drawing, joint, loop, dynamics, BIM/Draft, surfaces, mesh/reverse engineering and analysis/CAM variants remain unfinished. Typed mould-release Draft now adds measured planar/cylindrical face intent and native shell/boss/Hole compositions; this advances one modelling family without closing the broad application inventory. Native Spreadsheet aliases and affine unitful length formulas now drive editable Body histories, with owner native edit/reopen, source-copy isolation and workflow proofs; independent review, integrated Help and package acceptance remain open, so the breadth score is unchanged. Checked closed-STL preparation supports faceted Part/refine/boolean workflows and checked imported stock can seed editable Bodies; broad mesh repair, decimation and scan reconstruction remain missing. The subjective breadth score is unchanged. Editable straight-edged Draft polygon profiles now compose native Part extrusion/booleans with full trusted source and save-state binding; broader Draft and current integrated acceptance remain open. The subjective score is unchanged. Imported-solid Body stock and explicit layouts have source-bound owner product, native edit/reopen, save/authority and independent held-out source/assembly/GUI/removal evidence. First/final seed-only stock now composes through an exact finite empty-inline-table policy, with full fresh payload binding and no geometry tolerance change. Exact integrated/package acceptance and broader application families remain open. Application-wide denominator and scores are unchanged. Named flat-tool CAM and geometric drilling-cycle intent are implementing with independently parsed controller state, per-tool depth-specific removal and whole trusted saved-Job reconstruction. Pointed drills, explicit tip/full-diameter depths and finite aboveBlank/evolvingStock physical-tool/holder policies now have source-bound owner native, GUI edit/reopen, authority and lifecycle proof. An optional reduced shank retains its complete native template/extension and real shoulder, with an independently reviewed copy/edit/reopen path. Full current product/integration/package gates remain open; exterior holding, other cutters, machine constraints and broad CAM strategies stay required unfinished breadth. Scores and the whole-application denominator are unchanged. Finite pure generation1 Pad/Pocket, selected-final-Body generation2 histories and admitted primitive/import seeds now retain complete typed source intent. Whole native source and assembly-copy reconstruction, bounded trusted SDK save states and retired-source reuse have source-bound owner evidence and independent source review. The portable public qualifier now has source-bound native and installed-package acceptance for this finite Body-history milestone. Explicit unseeded Body frames now have typed world-carrier selection, local assembly witnesses, WORLD named measurements, authoring examples and a public lifecycle qualifier. Current combined native/package qualification remains open. Whole-application scores and denominator are unchanged. Typed helical material modes, native world-frame named measures and original-geometry empirical closed-boundary diagnostics now compose in the integrated candidate. Isolated auxiliary conic lenses close two finite period/tangent availability classes while retaining original curves. This remains empirical numerical evidence, with unmodelled endpoint and three-dimensional closure gaps; combined integrated/package acceptance and broad modelling families remain open. Application-wide scores and denominator are unchanged.

scope.description: Declared mechanical design, general named sketch relations, capsule slots, checked planar-face intent, per-Body feature histories, named length drivers, measured studies and fixed sourced assemblies.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Common rectangle/circle/slot intent lowers to native constrained sketches. Planar-face intent resolves exact cardinality and preserves attachment links; explicit per-Body history prevents hidden branching. General geometry relations name semantic endpoints instead of native indices. Users still author ordered features, general constraints and topology-sensitive choices; broader mechanisms, CAM, analysis and modelling workflows remain incomplete. Static-solid FEM expresses material and geometric support/traction intent rather than mesh-node indices or solver cards. Drilling layout intent compiles native pitch/phase constraints and fixed expressions rather than authored geometry indices or duplicated diameter values. A shell expresses thickness once and opening-face intent without indices; a shared wall dimension propagates into attached bosses, drilling and a second Body lid. Bend radius/angle intent compiles solved construction geometry; one wall dimension controls nested sweep sections and flange bores, and persistent centre-of-mass attachments follow moving faces without user constraint indices. Named joint endpoint/duration intent compiles native angular/linear formulas and sampled rigid-tree trajectories; it does not require authored native object paths or Python. General prescribed mechanisms remain unfinished. Draft faces use exact-cardinality geometric predicates and an explicit same-Body neutral profile plane rather than native face numbers; optional datum pull axes and native history preserve editable intent. Named tool IDs and source-frame hole layouts lower into native controllers, geometric edge targets and finite drilling cycles, avoiding authored tool-library paths, native indices and raw NC. Independent replay uses the selected cutter footprint at each depth. Physical clearance intent separates cutting reach, actual shank geometry, ordered stepped holders and tip/full-diameter depth; it compiles native tools and complete motion checks without authored Python, native property paths or NC.

limitations: Stable FreeCAD capability families remain unfinished; this accepted mechanical-design milestone is not whole-application completion. See docs/freecad-capabilities.md for specific remaining gaps.

Editorial percentages are conservative subjective assessments, not tested API percentages. Native receipts and source identities separately establish qualified workflows; unrelated earlier live/assembly/import receipts retain their original scope.

Native engineering tables currently cover bounded affine length formulas driving part dimensions. Angular/nonlinear/general-table and cross-document spreadsheet workflows remain missing; this foundation is not whole-application completion.
STL preparation retains faceted geometry and native Part edits; it does not recover analytical surfaces, scan-fitting intent, colours or foreign Body/assembly feature histories from a mesh.
Draft profiles currently cover straight closed boundaries and native Points/Placement edits; curves, dimensions, arrays, snapping, Body seeding and sourced-history copying remain unfinished.

Portable typed Body captures compare whole reachable trusted SDK states under one 120-second verification budget; repeated states may conservatively refuse. Scheduled fresh verification currently repeats complete source closure four times. Explicit Body.frame support retains local feature/assembly coordinates and applies world layout once; current integrated qualification is separate from whole-application completion.

Helical solid measures use bounded empirical completed-boundary diagnostics, not certified errors or physical mass. Conic/rational endpoint joins, three-dimensional rung/cap gaps and native/quadrature roundoff remain unmodelled; other unresolved conic configurations refuse. The authored turn bound does not guarantee numerical availability.
